answers.how: The car moves about 303 pixels/s, giving 30/303 meters per pixel. Its length is about 59 pixels.
Using 30/303 meters per pixel from the car's motion, its roughly 19-pixel height converts to 1.88 m.
The fully visible plane is about 383 pixels long. Using the car-derived scale of 30/303 meters per pixel gives 37.9 m.
The plane is about 114 pixels tall. Using the car-derived scale of 30/303 meters per pixel gives 11.3 m.
